front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《8》

zh: 風中有我想對你唱的歌
en: Dusk, fine rain
The color of the grass, like cloud and smoke, drifts far away
In the wind is the song I want to sing to you

points.zh:
《當你老了》 《When You Are Old 》
詞曲: 趙照   原唱: 趙照
當你老了  頭髮白了  睡意昏沉
當你老了  走不動了
爐火旁打盹  回憶青春
當你老了    眼眉低垂
燈火    昏黃不定風吹過來    你的消息
這就是我心裡的歌
當我老了    我真希望
這首歌是唱給你的

zh: 一塊色，一條線，幾處留白
en: Let oneself turn into scenery
A patch of color, a single line, a few empty spaces
And then the fog rose
The journey is long
Turning around
Is there also a homeland?

zh: 坐著吧， 隔街就是美術館
一杯咖啡， 幾分閒淡
en: Sit down, the art museum is just across the street
A cup of coffee, a touch of quiet ease
The Left Bank of the Seine

points.zh: 塞納河左岸是指巴黎塞納河以南的地區，精確講是指聖 . 米歇爾大街和聖 . 日爾曼大街交匯附近方圓幾公里地方，也就是巴黎的拉丁區。有說 :「在塞納河右岸用錢，左岸用腦」。提起左岸，就連想起一些氛圍或背景 : 大學，敎授，公園，咖啡館，哲學，詩歌，貴族，藝術，清談，閒適---當然還有文化。左岸的環境是叛逆的，心靈是孤寂的，眼神是激情的，語言是感性的，作風是獨特的，人文是色彩的。左岸的放蕩不羈，真實自然的靈瑰，造就了法國「思想大國」的超然地位。相對的右岸，在大銀行，金融集團，保險公司，股票交易所中流動著理性，中庯，奢華，繁榮，嚴肅等實事求是的刻板氣氛。

zh: 你爲我閃過的每個念頭
en: Every thought that flashed through you for me
Assembled together
That is my life, like a poem

zh: 山是起伏的字    樹是翠綠的字
風是飄浮的字    湖是烟波的字
en: The mountain is an undulating word, the tree is a word of emerald green
Wind is a drifting word; the lake is a word of misted waves
The road home is written in the words of homesickness
After the fine snow
Pine branches and dusk each surrender their own
A stretch of stillness
If we cannot exchange
A heart's concern nearly moved to tears
Then let it drift away on the wind
Life always has its faults, great and small
Crisscrossing, jostling
Deep within, crystallizing into a riddle

zh: 指望的，  或許已隨波流遠
en: Tamsui welcomes the dusk
Recalling the past, faint as smoke
What was hoped for may have already drifted far with the current

points.zh:
《 淡水暮色 》
詞：葉俊麟   曲：洪一峰
淡水黃昏帶詩意　夜霧罩四邊
教堂鐘聲心空虛　響對海面去
埔頂燈光真稀微　閃閃像天星
啊 ~ 難忘的  情景引心悲

白靈 。 文  《 屬於台灣畫家陳澄波的淡水 》 2014/4
到過台北的人，很少不去淡水的。但現在的淡水與我20歲時見過的淡水仿佛是兩個景觀，而我所見到的又與陳澄波畫作《 淡水夕照 》中的淡水顯然也有極大差異。他的《 淡水夕照 》這幅畫在2007年，於香港國際拍賣會上曾以2.15億新台幣拍出，創台灣畫家油畫的最高價。 此畫作中的景物彷彿由30層樓的空中俯視，淡水河在左，由下方向上方流去，由小面積而大面積而漸壯闊，一排中式古厝紅瓦白牆，由下方向上向遠處曲折蛇行、躍動起伏且緩慢縮小，伴著西式馬偕教堂及散落的綠蔭樹叢，一路綿延向畫的最上方，直到夕陽天光的海平面，幾乎與遠遠的紅毛城相匯為止。構圖奇特，色彩像是自整個天空灑下了斑斕的顏料，紅光霞輝浸淫整幅畫面，令人神怡心曠。陳澄波的淡水系列至少十張，保存了最少的日式，而僅有閩式與歐式建築相互呼吸互動、融洽匯聚，那是屬於陳澄波的淡水小鎮。這種屬於陳澄波的淡水是由古厝、夕陽、與陳澄波熱情的畫筆共同熔鑄完成的。單單這一幅畫，古老的淡水就永垂不朽了。
陳澄波 ( 1895 ~ 1947 ) 台灣嘉義人，畫家。1926年以《 嘉義街外 》作品，入選日本「帝國美術院展覽會」，是首次以西畫跨進日本官展的台灣人。其後又數度入選「帝展」。1947年二二八事件期間，被國民政府軍隊逮捕，示眾羞辱，槍殺於嘉義火車站前。陳澄波一生縱橫台灣，東京和上海的現代藝術風潮，在美術史上具舉足輕重的代表性，畫中洋溢著對故鄉及時代的熱情及感染力，透過畫面呈現二十世紀初期，台灣的風土人情，以及台灣藝術邁入現代化過程的複雜樣貌。其精彩豐富，悲劇性的一生，反映台灣藝術史在不同政權統治下，所經歷的曲折波濤。同時也是近代東亞美術現代化過程的歷史縮影 。
points.en:
Bai Ling, essay, 'The Tamsui That Belongs to the Taiwanese Painter Chen Cheng-po,' April 2014
Few who have visited Taipei have not also gone to Tamsui. But the Tamsui of today seems almost a different place from the Tamsui I saw at twenty, and what I saw is clearly also quite different from the Tamsui in Chen Cheng-po's painting 'Tamsui at Sunset.' This painting sold for NT$215 million at a Hong Kong international auction in 2007, setting the record price for an oil painting by a Taiwanese artist. The scenery in this painting appears as if viewed from the air, from the height of a 30-story building; the Tamsui River lies on the left, flowing from the bottom of the picture upward, its area widening and its scale growing ever more expansive; a row of Chinese-style old houses with red tiles and white walls winds upward from the bottom toward the distance, rising and falling in gentle, gradually diminishing motion, accompanied by the Western-style Mackay Memorial Church and scattered patches of green shade, stretching all the way to the top of the painting, until it meets the sea horizon beneath the light of the setting sun, almost converging with the distant Fort San Domingo (Hongmao Cheng). The composition is remarkable, its colors as if brilliant pigments had been poured down from the whole sky; a red glow of sunset light suffuses the entire canvas, leaving the viewer in a state of blissful, expansive ease. Chen Cheng-po's Tamsui series numbers at least ten paintings, preserving the fewest Japanese-style elements, with only Fujian-style and European-style architecture breathing and interacting with one another — this is the Tamsui town that belongs to Chen Cheng-po. This Tamsui belonging to Chen Cheng-po was forged together from the old houses, the setting sun, and Chen Cheng-po's passionate brush. With this single painting alone, old Tamsui has been rendered immortal.
Chen Cheng-po (1895–1947), a painter born in Chiayi, Taiwan, had his work 'Outside Chiayi Street' selected for Japan's Imperial Art Academy Exhibition in 1926, making him the first Taiwanese to enter a Japanese official exhibition with a Western-style painting. He was subsequently selected for the Imperial Exhibition several more times. During the 228 Incident of 1947, he was arrested by Nationalist government troops, publicly humiliated, and shot in front of Chiayi Railway Station. Chen Cheng-po's life spanned the modern art movements of Taiwan, Tokyo, and Shanghai, and he holds a pivotal, representative place in art history; his paintings overflow with passion for his homeland and his era, presenting through their imagery the customs and character of Taiwan in the early twentieth century, and the complex process by which Taiwanese art entered modernity. His rich, vivid, and tragic life reflects the twists and turns experienced by Taiwan's art history under different ruling regimes, and is also a historical microcosm of the modernization process of modern East Asian art.
